title: Cold Days and Snow
text:
It is cold today. The wind is strong and the sky is gray. Yesterday it was hot and sunny. I like hot days.

Tomorrow it will snow in the mountains. My brother wants to ski. I think it is too cold for me. I will stay home with a warm cup of tea.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
How does the writer probably feel about cold weather?
options: The writer does not like it
The writer is very excited about it
The writer does not notice it
The writer wants to go skiing

questions.text: Why will the writer probably stay home tomorrow?
options: Because it will be too cold
Because the writer has no tea
Because the writer wants to ski

paragraph_translations: Hoje está frio. O vento é forte e o céu está cinza. Ontem estava quente e ensolarado. Eu gosto de dias quentes.
Amanhã vai nevar nas montanhas. Meu irmão quer esquiar. Eu acho que está frio demais para mim. Vou ficar em casa com uma xícara de chá quente.
